policy.lossless: all-pixel exact in same decoded color domain; normalized-color tolerance alone is not a lossless T03 pass
policy.lossy_basis: predeclared decoder-to-decoder difference on same compressed input
policy.color_basis: predeclared YBR-to-RGB integer rounding difference; normalized domain only
policy.modality_total_allowance: arithmetic allowance + decoder allowance; lossless stored tolerance remains zero
policy.functional_group_modality_reference: Shared/PerFrame PixelValueTransformationSequence presence makes Modality not-run; stored, metadata and frame comparisons remain required
policy.selected_frame_policy: all synthetic frames; public first/middle/last plus all bulk individual-frame outputs
policy.not_covered: VOI/display/ROI/GPU/cache lifetime/renderer performance/full T13 are outside this P0 experiment
policy.synthetic_roundtrip: readback check only; explicit formulas remain golden; public independent decode is compatibility evidence
